models.long_text: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (Q4_K_M GGUF, Apache-2.0) via llama.cpp llama-server

risks: Net revenues decreased to $275.5 million in 2025 from $326.5 million in 2024 and $343.4 million in 2023.
Sales of the Beyond Burger account for a significant portion of revenue and any reduction could severely impact financial condition.
Beyond Meat faces intense competition from numerous plant-based and alternative protein companies, which may limit its growth and profitability.
Beyond Meat may not have enough cash or be able to obtain financing to repurchase the Notes upon a Fundamental Change.
Beyond Meat faces significant risks due to data privacy and security regulations, including potential penalties and costs.

growth_drivers: Beyond Meat launched Beyond Immerse, a plant-based protein beverage.
Beyond Meat expects to drive net revenue through the expansion of its retail and foodservice channels, especially in plant-based products.
Beyond Meat offers plant-based meat products that deliver the taste and texture of animal-based meat while providing nutritional and environmental benefits.
We plan to innovate and commercialize products to drive consumer adoption of our products.
We expect greater demand for our products during the U.S. summer grilling season.
risks: Ongoing, further weakened demand in the plant-based meat category and for our products, particularly in the refrigerated plant-based meat subsegment.
Net revenues decreased due to lower sales and reduced points of distribution.
Net revenues from U.S. retail channel sales decreased $3.3 million in the three months ended June 27, 2026.
Net revenues from international foodservice channel sales decreased due to lower sales of burger and chicken products to certain QSR customers.
Inflation, tariffs, and high interest rates have increased disruption and volatility in capital markets, potentially harming liquidity.

growth_drivers: Beyond Meat Jerky was sold to a specific partner, but was discontinued in 2024.
risks: Net revenues decreased $51.0 million, or 15.6%, primarily due to weak category demand and lower sales.
Beyond Meat recorded a $49.0 million loss on write-down of assets held for sale.
Beyond Meat incurred workforce reduction charges of $1.8 million in 2023 and $1.2 million in 2025.
Beyond Meat recorded $0.4 million in one-time cash charges related to the China RIF and $1.1 million for the August 2025 RIF.
Beyond Meat was in default of the Loan and Security Agreement due to late delivery of audited financial statements.

growth_drivers: Beyond Meat's Beyond Steak Filet is one of their best-selling items online.
Beyond Meat launched Beyond Breakfast sausage and Beyond Immerse, a plant-based beverage targeting the functional drink market.
Beyond Meat is launching a new agave-sweetened product with Big Geyser, a New York distributor.
Beyond Meat sees stronger acceptance in Europe due to climate concerns and less industry misinformation.
risks: Net revenues decreased 8.2% to $68.8 million in the second quarter of 2026.
